query.description: What the caller needs to know, in its own words.

entry_id.description: Index entry to use: an id or keyword tpu-knowledge-base returned earlier. Omit it otherwise, and the agent searches with `query`; a guessed one lands on the nearest match.

vars.description: Overrides for values normally read from the environment.

allow_crawl.description: True (the default): a url with no current kept page is read now -- by the harness CLI, or downloaded for the subagent to summarise and keep. False: nothing is read; only pages on disk and current kept pages are served, a url with neither comes back as a citation without content (not_read), and a key nothing serves gets no answer.

run_id.description: Optional. The session run, when the caller has one. Given, this run's lookup jobs are kept in its artifacts; omitted, they go to the shared jobs directory and the lookup is unaffected. Callers need not obtain one to ask a question.
